description: This file declares functions, macros, and constants related to URL processing within the cURL library, including connection setup, URL scheme handling, and protocol-specific configurations.

methods.name: Curl_init_do
methods.description: Initializes HTTP transfer based on the provided data and connection.

methods.name: Curl_open
methods.description: Opens and initializes a new CURL handle.

methods.name: Curl_init_userdefined
methods.description: Performs user-defined additional initialization on a CURL handle.

methods.name: Curl_freeset
methods.description: Frees or resets the settings of a CURL handle.

methods.name: Curl_uc_to_curlcode
methods.description: Converts a CURLUcode to a CURLcode.

methods.name: Curl_close
methods.description: Closes and cleans up a CURL handle.

methods.name: Curl_connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection for the given CURL handle.

methods.name: Curl_disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects and cleans up the connection associated with the CURL handle.

methods.name: Curl_setup_conn
methods.description: Sets up connection parameters for the CURL handle.

methods.name: Curl_parse_login_details
methods.description: Parses login details from a string into user, password, and options.

methods.name: Curl_get_scheme_handler
methods.description: Retrieves the protocol handler for a URL scheme, case-insensitive.

methods.name: Curl_getn_scheme_handler
methods.description: Retrieves the protocol handler for a URL scheme with a specified length.

methods.name: Curl_verboseconnect
methods.description: Outputs verbose connection information if enabled.

methods.name: Curl_data_priority_clear_state
methods.description: Clears data priority state, related to HTTP/2 or HTTP/3.

methods.name: Curl_data_priority_add_child
methods.description: Adds a child data stream with priority, used in HTTP/2/3.
